items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the general municipal law and the public authorities law, in
relation to county-wide shared services panels
items.lawCode: Amd §239-bb, Gen Muni L; ren Art 5 Title 5-A §§1114-a - 1114-s to be Title 5-B §§1114-aa - 1114-ss, Pub Auth L
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S5173

SPONSOR: RHOADS
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the general municipal law and the public authorities
law, in relation to county-wide shared services panels

 
PURPOSE:

The purpose of this bill is to clarify eligibility of the newly estab-
lished South Nassau Water Authority under section 239-bb of the general
municipal law.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1. amends section 239-bb of the general municipal law by adding
title five-B of article five of the public authorities law.

Section 2. amends title 5-A of article 5 of the public authorities law
by renumbering and creating a title 5-B

Section 3. is the enacting clause.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

This bill will clarify language under Title 5 of article 5-A of the
Public Authorities Law to ensure funding for the South Nassau Water
Authority and North Shore Water Authority.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

S7864/A9307 - Veto Memo.44

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.
